identityReview.rule: The user-approved generated V4 front-face lock may parent downstream V4 renders as a translation control, but it never replaces or outranks the real Lulu identity evidence.

canonicalFlow.rule: 006 and 007 are independent sibling views branching from accepted 005 and the same canonical stack. Neither may parent, gate, or provide generation authority for the other.

garment.rule: 004 always means the same black floor-length gown with the white folded neckline. Garment intake is the first input to every view operation.

identity.rule: Resolve identity from the verified F01-F10 multi-angle contact sheet, the recovered raw frontal and open-eye three-quarter photographs, and the real-photo frontal face lock. The user-approved generated V4 face lock supplies repeatable translation geometry but may not override real identity. Accepted 001/05 and 004/05 supply garment-specific JUW translation guidance only. V3 is legacy comparison only. The close frontal reference controls morphology and texture but not open-eye geometry or total head proportions. Face must pass before body or room work begins, and no sibling view has identity authority over another sibling.

body.rule: Real Lulu photos remain body evidence truth. The V4 source and three-view plate are user-approved modeled silhouette and garment-transfer controls, not verified measurements. Preserve the geometry as a balanced whole: no caricatured waist, posterior exaggeration, flattening, shortened legs or upper-thigh reduction. Individual view crops are operational conveniences only.

atelier.rule: The room is a permanent building and must remain pixel-stable.

brand.rule: The wall icon is inherited from the locked room and may not be regenerated.

semanticMediaRoles.rule: Semantic role names are authoritative. Numeric slots are presentation and packet conventions only; map by role before export, database sync or Shop publication.

outputFormat.rule: One clean full-resolution image without labels, panels, text or crops.

accepted06.note: The accepted 006 is preserved as its own output. It is not an input, parent, prerequisite or authority for 007.

accepted07.note: The accepted 007 branches directly from 005 and the canonical stack. It is not an input, parent, prerequisite or authority for 006.
